title: Biopsy-Based Molecular Signatures Predicting Therapeutic Response in Ulcerative Colitis.
snippet: Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a chronic inflammatory bowel disease with marked molecular heterogeneity, resulting in highly variable responses to biologic therapies. Despite the efficacy of Infliximab (IFX), many patients fail to achieve sustained remission.
